description: Run every Sharelint check on a URL at once: link previews in 12 apps, AI visibility for ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, on-page SEO, iOS and Android app links, performance, and security basics. Use it for a general "check my website or link" request; use the focused tools when the question is about one of these.

crawler.description: User-Agent to fetch the page as for share previews. Defaults to Facebook’s crawler, which most apps resemble.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain to check, for example "example.com/pricing". Private and local addresses are refused.

name: check_url
title: Full link audit
